verdict.rationale: Orama's pricing page calls the search library open-source, the docs distinguish "Orama Open Source" from Orama Cloud, and the source is published in the public oramasearch/orama GitHub repository. So users can read the core library's source. missing for 10: the specific license is never named or cited, there is no evidence that the Cloud, context-server or MCP components are open, and there is no independent corroboration of the license terms.
